content:
Apple has begun iOS 27.2 beta testing, and this update brings several notable changes and new features. Here is everything you need to know about iOS 27.2, which is expected to roll out to iPhone users as early as next month.

Why iOS 27.2 instead of iOS 27.1?

Apple launched iOS 27 on September 14, bringing a host of new iPhone features including Siri AI. iOS 27.2 entered beta testing just two days later on September 16.

Where did iOS 27.1 go?

Apple previously confirmed that the iPhone Duo will ship with iOS 27.1 pre-installed when it goes on sale on October 23. This means the iOS 27.1 codebase contains a lot of iPhone Duo-related content that Apple wants to keep under wraps until the device officially launches. So iOS 27.1 will only be pre-installed exclusively on the iPhone Duo.

The software branches for the iPhone Duo and other iPhone models will eventually merge, possibly through an iOS 27.2.x update, or potentially iOS 27.3.

So there will be a brief awkward period, but eventually everything will return to normal.

iOS 27.2 new features

Redesigned Health app

At the iPhone 18 Pro launch event, Apple unveiled a brand new version of the Health app, saying it would arrive later this year. This new app has already entered beta testing alongside iOS 27.2.

The redesigned Health app is divided into three tabs: Insights, Longevity, and Browse. The app features a completely new design that dynamically adjusts based on your data, including Apple Intelligence. The Longevity tab adds a Health Age feature that uses Apple Watch data to show how your various metrics compare to your actual age.

The new Health app will not launch next month alongside iOS 27.2. Instead, Apple is first rolling out beta testing for the new app, with a full release to all users coming later.

Learn more: iOS 27.2 brings a major overhaul to Apple Health app—here are the new features

Personal profiles added to TV app

The Apple TV app in iOS 27.2 supports personal profiles for the first time. This feature has been available on tvOS for years, but this marks its debut on iPhone.

Learn more: iOS 27.2 brings new personal profiles feature to Apple TV on iPhone

More Siri AI languages

Siri AI is a key new feature of iOS 27, and iOS 27.2 extends this feature to more users. This update adds Siri AI support for the following languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Dual-camera mode for group FaceTime

In iOS 27, Apple added a brand new dual-camera feature to FaceTime, allowing your front and rear cameras to work simultaneously. The other party sees you as well as what's in front of you. iOS 27.2 extends this feature to group FaceTime calls for the first time.

The dual-camera feature requires an iPhone 17 or later, and everyone on the call must be running iOS 27.

Learn more: iOS 27.2 makes FaceTime's best new feature even better

Other details

  • In Apple Podcasts, the "Up Next" playlist has been renamed to "New Episodes." The "Continue Playing" section now appears directly below "New Episodes." The background color of episode lists now matches the Podcast cover artwork.
  • Some red icons and accents in the Music app have been changed to black.
  • iOS 27's Call Context feature, which displays relevant information on-screen when you call a business, has now been expanded to include anniversaries.
  • There are subtle changes to the alarm interface in the Clock app, such as smaller fonts for AM and PM labels.

Hints at upcoming features

Finally, the iOS 27.2 codebase hints at several new features that may be coming to iPhone soon. These include real-time countdowns for new album releases on Apple Music, third-party app support for "Describe Shortcuts," and new themes for CarPlay Ultra. iOS 27.2 also shows that Apple continues to develop iPhone anti-theft features.

These features are not yet live in iOS 27.2, but the codebase shows Apple is actively developing them internally.

iOS 27.2 release date

iOS 27.2 is expected to roll out to iPhone users at some point in October. Apple has promised that Siri AI will add more languages in October, and iOS 27.2 adds exactly these new languages, so the update must launch before November for Apple to keep its promise.

Summary

Are you currently running the iOS 27.2 beta? Have you found any useful new features? What do you think of the new Health app? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
